question: Should OpenClaw core accept a bounded durable `gateway_restart_audit` table that stores restart source, actor/device/client-IP context, redacted session fingerprints, and safe-restart preflight metadata?
rationale: This is not just a mechanical code fix: it creates a new durable operator-forensics store on an availability-sensitive restart path and changes the privacy/security boundary for restart metadata.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Refresh the PR against current main, preserve existing restart behavior, and merge with the 512-row retention and current redaction policy.

options.title: Narrow The Audit Contract
options.body: Require stronger minimization before merge, such as removing client IP/device fields from durable JSON or limiting persisted preflight detail.

options.title: Reject Durable Storage
options.body: Close or pause this direction and keep restart attribution in logs/diagnostics instead of a shared SQLite audit table.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the PR against current main, preserve existing restart behavior, and merge with the 512-row retention and current redaction policy.
